description.fun: Sawk shuts itself away in the mountains in pursuit of the strongest karate chop, training without sleep, and the sound of it punching boulders and trees carries all the way down. A Sawk trained to the limit can cleave the ocean itself. Tightening its belt pumps it up, and disturbing its training is a bad idea, so pass by quietly. Its single eyebrow is likely what's left of a horn from its early design.
description.guide: Sawk is a Fighting-type Pokémon modelled on a karate practitioner, always male, that trains alone in the mountains to perfect its karate chop. It becomes angry if its training is disturbed. It is the counterpart of Throh and does not evolve.
description.tagline: A karate hermit whose chops can split the sea.
